description: Map-derived local inverse validation. Each target starts from a deterministic v2-atlas contour proposal, then uses the unchanged M20 trust-region search and same-geometry independent M25 check.
scope: Exploratory local validation of map-proposed starts. Successful local searches do not establish a unique inverse, global reachability, full-Brillouin-zone gaps, continuum convergence, or PWE-COMSOL agreement.
